blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Authorities have identified 63 of the 77 people killed in the MV June Aster ferry fire off Palawan in September, the Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) has reported. The BFP also said Friday eight people remain missing as investigators continue to determine possible lapses that allowed the vessel to sail despite engine problems and the improper storage of flammable and hazardous cargo. BFP officer-in-charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil Ang Kwan Tiu disclosed the findings during a Palace briefing, where the agency presented an artificial intelligence-generated narration of the events leading to the fire based on survivors’ […]...
